description.narrative: The objective is to rehabilitate and upgrade the water supply system, treatment facilities, pumping stations and sewer network. Rehabilitation and upgrading of water supply systems, treatment facilities, pumping stations, and sewers network. Also included will be technical assistance and capacity building for implementation support and preparation of future projects. 09/28/05. The Project Concept review meeting will depend on meeting with MOB team in early November. 11/01/05. Concept review now planned for end-December 2005. 11/29/05. The Concept review was delayed to end of January since MOB has not presented their proposals. The BAnk team will meet with MOB in Beirut 12/6-10 to discuss/review MOB proposals. 01/24/06. The Concept review is scheduled for mid March 2006 pending outcome of detailed designs completion of C01-05 contract (under ongoing ITF project). This will determine the final number of packages to be included in this project. 06/11/06 On track -- moving faster than anticipated since we have had continuity with the Mayor in contrast with the first project. 09/08/06. During the August 2006 mission the team updated the preparation timetable for the above project. It became apparent that if the PHRD application (now in process) is approved will become on the critical path of project processing and necessitate slipping the Board date to May 1, 2007 in order to allow enough time (5 months) to use the PHRD grant to complete the preparation of the Al-Ghazalya Sewerage Trunk Main. Appraisal departure slipped from November 2006 to January 2007. 10/31/06. Due to the current security situation and no progress, it was agreed to slip the Board approval date to July 2007. Mayor of Baghdad is visiting the US on December 11, 2006. 04/02/07. the CMU and SMU Directors agreed to slip the Board date until the implementation of the ongoing ITF project picks up. In case there aren't sufficient funds for this project under the initial IDA allocation of US$500, an IBRD will be considered. 06/01/07 CMU agreed to slip the Board date until there is more clarity on the IDA effectiveness and the allocation of the remaiming IDA tranche. 08/08/07. Because of the current sickness of the PMT Director (he was out July and August 2007), a new PMT Director has been appointed effective September 1. 9/24/07. The CMU wants to hold MOB II until there is significant improvement in the implementation of MOB I. Board approval date slipped from 3/11/08 to 6/19/08. 02/11/08. Board approval slipped from 6/19/08 to 9/18/08 and to 12/18/08 as per TTL's request. Further processing is pending status of ongoing project under implementation. The decision to drop was made by the Country Director as the ongoing project under implementation was not making good progress in addition to the lack of funds combined with high security situation. TTL changed from Suhail Jme'An to Sana Agha al Nimer. Awaiting closing of PHRD TF056970 which has now been extended by 2 months to end-February 2009.
